The '''Erhynradd system''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The event known as the [[Erhynradd Mutiny]]<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> occurred in the vicinity of the system<ref name="Battlenamia">{{Battlenamia|event=the [[Erhynradd Mutiny]]|system=Erhynradd system|legends=1}}</ref> in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|220|Tarkin, Gideon}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Erhynradd system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-13.<ref name="TEA" />
